requirements.responsibility: Turn user goals into bounded requirements and acceptance criteria
requirements.output: Requirements, exclusions, acceptance cases, unresolved decisions
requirements.done: Each requirement has an observable acceptance criterion

research.responsibility: Verify version-specific facts and primary sources
research.input: Research question and explicit network authorization
research.output: Sources, dates, installed-version evidence and uncertainties
research.tools: Read-only files; approved official documentation search
research.done: Claims are linked to sources or marked unknown

architect.responsibility: Map existing operations and choose the smallest integration
architect.output: ADR, dependencies, failure boundaries and migration constraints
architect.done: Existing components are reused and risky alternatives explained

domain.responsibility: Audit Linux, eBPF/XDP, Suricata and network isolation semantics
domain.output: Domain findings with source references and missing live gates
domain.tools: Read-only source and offline fixtures; no host probes
domain.done: Verifier, management and ownership limitations remain explicit

implementation.responsibility: Implement the assigned cohesive source package
implementation.input: Approved task, verified baseline, exclusive file claim
implementation.output: Scoped patch, rationale, tests and limitations
implementation.tools: Parent tools within assigned snapshot; offline checks only
implementation.done: Patch stays in scope and recorded checks support its behavior

qa.input: Task acceptance cases and candidate patch
qa.output: Executed command evidence, failures and NOT TESTED gates
qa.tools: Read-only inspection and explicit offline test commands
qa.done: Each acceptance claim has execution evidence or a blocker

security.responsibility: Independently challenge trust, permissions and failure handling
security.input: Candidate diff, policy and threat cases
security.output: Severity-ranked findings, reproduction and unresolved risks
security.tools: Read-only inspection and synthetic policy tests
security.done: Safety changes are reviewed without activating them

devops.responsibility: Design reproducible packaging and authorized deployment steps
devops.input: Build scripts, target constraints and release gates
devops.output: Offline validation and exact proposed dedicated-host steps
devops.tools: Read-only files and inert offline artifact checks
devops.done: No live provisioning or publication is implied by source presence

documentation.responsibility: Keep architecture, acceptance and recovery instructions accurate
documentation.output: Scoped documentation patch with evidence boundaries
documentation.tools: Parent tools within exclusively assigned documentation paths
documentation.done: Instructions distinguish synthetic, executed and live results

integrator.responsibility: Independently review and integrate the bounded package
integrator.input: Baseline, scoped patches, independent findings and test receipts
integrator.output: Acceptance or rejection bound to current tree fingerprint
integrator.tools: Read-only review; parent alone integrates shared files
integrator.done: No conflicts, stale evidence, self-review or unproven PASS remains
